verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents a first-party API that it says lets users 'take full control of your workflow,' alongside Zapier, so a programmatic surface exists. Nothing shows which UI actions it covers, and probes found no OpenAPI spec, no llms.txt and no markdown developer docs. Zapier is a third-party connector and earns no parity credit. Missing for 10: a published endpoint reference or OpenAPI spec, evidence that UI actions (scan/forward/ship requests, check deposit, automation rules, account settings) are exposed via API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.
